title: Female borrowers who emphasize improving the family's living situation may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who mention purchasing specific tools or devices may fund more slowly.
The inclusion of detailed local geography or personal biographical narratives about upbringing is associated with slower funding for both men and women.
Pitches from women that specify the loan amount in PHP and explicitly name the lender NWTF are associated with slower funding speeds.
Female borrowers who mention their spouse's employment may fund faster.
Female borrowers who include specific details about children or dependents may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who mention being high school graduates may fund faster.
Female borrowers who include specific biographical details like age and number of children may fund faster.
Female borrowers who explicitly mention their husband or marital status may fund more slowly.
Pitches from women that specify concrete goals for children's education or the pursuit of financial independence accelerate funding.
Female borrowers who list specific products or goals beyond family welfare fund faster.
Specifying the number of years a business has operated predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
Female borrowers who mention the goal of building savings fund faster.
Female borrowers who mention a history of successful loans from NWTF fund faster.
Higher verbosity and excessive personal detail predict slower funding regardless of gender.
Pitches that include specific monthly income figures predict slower funding regardless of gender.
Female borrowers who emphasize that their business is currently doing well or is being sustained fund faster.
Female borrowers who include their age and number of children fund more slowly.
